name: Geospatial
summary: Places and physical context — locations with coordinates, postal addresses, and facilities — to anchor the 'where' of an investigation.
description:
Node types for the physical side of an investigation: a named place with optional coordinates, a postal address, and a physical site such as an office, a datacenter or a residence.

The pack is data only: it defines three node types in the `geo` category and runs no code. It declares no edge types; tying a person, an organisation or a server to a place is recorded as an edge in the project.

## Types

| Type | Label | What it represents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `geo.location` | `name` | A named geographic location with optional coordinates |
| `geo.address` | `formatted_address` | A postal or street address |
| `geo.facility` | `name` | A physical site such as an office, datacenter or residence |

Each type is identified by its label field alone, so two locations recorded under the same `name`, or two facilities with the same `name`, are one node.

## Notable properties

- **Location.** `latitude` (-90 to 90) and `longitude` (-180 to 180) in decimal degrees, with `city`, `region` (state or region) and `country`.
- **Address.** The full `formatted_address`, with `street`, `city`, `postal_code` and `country` as separate fields.
- **Facility.** `facility_type`, one of `office`, `datacenter`, `residence`, `warehouse`, `government`, `military`, `other`, and `operator`, the operating organisation.

`country` is free text in all three types; the pack does not prescribe a code list.

## Source

https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/typepack-basic (file `typepacks/geo.json`). Licence: Apache-2.0.
